name.zh-CN: 每日早 8 点热点获客选题生成
name.en-US: Daily 8 AM Trending Lead-Gen Topic Generator

prompt.zh-CN: 检索本行业近 24 小时热点痛点，生成 3 组带 CTA 钩子与归因短链的获客草稿，并推送至飞书/Telegram 等待人工确认排期。
prompt.en-US: Research top industry pain points from the last 24h, draft 3 lead-gen posts with CTA hooks and UTM short-links, and notify IM for human approval.

name.zh-CN: 每 4 小时矩阵账号授权与排期巡检

prompt.zh-CN: 巡检所有已授权平台的 Token 有效期与待发队列，如发现 Auth Expired 立即告警提醒。
prompt.en-US: Inspect OAuth token health and queued posts across all enabled channels; alert immediately on any Auth Expired status.

name.zh-CN: 每日晚 8 点获客线索与 ROI 战报推送
name.en-US: Daily 8 PM Lead Funnel & ROI Digest

prompt.zh-CN: 汇总今日短链点击、S/A 高意向评论数、新入库线索与成交转化，输出中英双语战报并推送至远程 IM 通道。
prompt.en-US: Summarize today's short-link clicks, S/A intent comments, new CRM leads, and closed revenue; push digest to connected IM channel.
